$comment: Per-seat model/effort tiers for Codex seats (review, implementer, fixer, mop-up) (skills/shared/review-backend.md §Seat tiers). Every seat runs one model, gpt-6.2-sol, so a tier differs only in effort; every tier pins service_tier default so no seat pays the priority rate. Explore has no Codex seat — it is the host's built-in Claude agent. Resolution: --model/--effort > --tier > templates[template] > seats[seat] > seats['*']. A null model/effort inherits the run home's config.toml (the user's Codex defaults). Warm continuations (--resume) never re-tier: the thread keeps the model it was opened with. Override the whole table for an experiment with SF_CODEX_TIERS=<path>.

frontier.note: the gates of record: the plan reviewer, the plan-stage and code-stage failure-over-time seats, the routed domain reviewer for the touched workspace, and the seats['*'] default

standard.note: structural and performance reads (architecture, performance), where more reasoning per file pays

standard-light.note: enumeration and fix-commit-only reads (test-coverage-guardian, the regression template)

writer.note: the writer seats — implementer, fixer, mop-up: bounded by the plan or the findings, and every commit is gated by review, the build and the acceptance checks
